name: >>Fami! Kyou no Menu wa Lesson C
original_name: >>ふぁみ! 今日のメニューはレッスンC
source:
One day, Masaki is recruited as a training teacher at waitress training school. He is engaged in two jobs at the same time being a high school student in the morning and a teacher in the evening.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090303064503/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003411]Eroge Shop[/url]]
